title: AgentControl OPA decision response
description: OPA DataResponseV1 as consumed by AgentControl. Verified against refs/opa@515aea3 v1/server/types/types.go:267-282.

decision_id.description: OPA audit id. Present only when the decision-log plugin is configured (v1/runtime/runtime.go:930-938); absent otherwise. Maps to agentcontrol.policy.decision_id.

decision.description: Any other value, or a missing result object, is treated as provider failure and resolved by fail_mode.

policy_id.description: Rule identifier. Always supplied by the policy so FR-022 holds even without OPA decision logging.

review_timeout_seconds.description: Required when decision == 'review'. The review window lives in policy, not provider config (FR-016).
